items.title: Iran's president tells Trump it will never 'bend the knee'
items.description: Masoud Pezeshkian's defiant speech to the UN comes after the US president threatened to "annihilate" Iran if a peace deal is not agreed soon.

items.title: Ethiopia and Tigray accuse each of launching offensives, fuelling fears of new war
items.description: The local authorities reportedly seize Tigray's airports following reports of recent drone strikes.

items.title: White House rolling out red carpet for historic Xi Jinping visit
items.description: Trump and Xi are expected to discuss a range of issues from trade to AI during the latter's multi-day visit to Washington.

items.title: Dramatic eviction of woman aged 87 highlights Spain's housing shortage
items.description: The tenant of the flat in Madrid, Maricarmen, was unable to pay the rent set by the firm which recently bought it.

items.title: Dolly Parton's manager accuses her nephew of 'threats and intimidation'
items.description: Bryan Seaver, who announced Parton's death to the world, is accused of trying to extort her estate.

items.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in prison for sexual assault
items.description: In court, Miriam Haley said the assault had a "devastating effect on my life and sense of security that may never go away".

items.title: Poland accuses Russian military helicopter of violating its airspace
items.description: Poland says the aircraft stayed in its skies for 42 seconds, forcing the Nato member to scramble its fighter jets.

items.title: Reports of violence against women in Gaza surge, UN agency finds
items.description: The UN Population Fund also says there has been a "severe escalation" in the number of early and forced marriages.

items.title: Eleven killed in mass shooting at house in South Africa
items.description: One of those killed is believed to be a pregnant woman, police said.

items.title: Trump administration accuses banned media outlets of 'falsehoods' ahead of court hearing
items.description: The US Justice Department's response to a lawsuit filed by CNN, Politico and MS NOW also cites national security.

items.title: Azerbaijan pardons Frenchman after EU lifts sanctions on Russian billionaire
items.description: Martin Ryan is pardoned months after he was jailed on charges of spying, but a second Frenchman remains in prison.

items.title: Trump meets US-backed Venezuelan president for first time since Maduro seized
items.description: Rodriguez was handpicked by Trump as leader of Venezuela was arrested and taken to the US

items.title: South Sudan's president dissolves government ahead of country's first elections
items.description: South Sudan has not held elections since independence in 2011 - polls have twice been postponed.

items.title: Hurricane Polo downgraded but remains 'very powerful' off coast of Mexico
items.description: The large storm in the Pacific Ocean is being driven by warm waters caused by the El Niño weather phenomenon.

items.title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine
items.description: Ukraine will get access to OpenAI's advanced GPT 5.6 Sol model under the deal - a rival to Anthropic's Mythos and Fable

items.title: Angry Anderson, rock star who soundtracked Kylie's wedding in Neighbours, dies aged 79
items.description: He fronted the rock band Rose Tattoo, but became best known for his solo hit Suddenly.

items.title: US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark
items.description: The defence deal signed at the UN General Assembly also re-affirms Denmark's sovereignty over its semi-autonomous Arctic territory.

items.title: How Ceuta, football and Israel are shaping Morocco's election
items.description: Young voters are being courted with football slogans, promises of jobs and anti-Israel rallying calls.

items.title: Huge data centres rise at 'China speed' to power its AI ambitions
items.description: The BBC visits Inner Mongolia, an unlikely frontier in Beijing's AI race with Washington.

items.title: Playing loud music on the bus? That will cost you hundreds of dollars in Singapore
items.description: Authorities are cracking down on "disruptive behaviours" including eating onboard and putting feet on seats.
